scope: weight-only MPO site-order selection for the high_fidelity_10x zero-healing stack
hypothesis: One shared ordering of the four tensorized channel sites may lower rank-truncation error across a contiguous layer stack. It preserves each dense linear operator exactly before compression and adds no healing or training step.

method.selection: For each candidate site order, compute normalized TT-SVD truncation bounds at the high_fidelity_10x ranks over representative layers and projections; rank orders by mean bound, with maximum bound as tie-breaker.
method.caveat: This is a weight-only proxy. It excludes Nox bridge, sparse shield, activation-weighted DMRG refinement, component quantization, attention/MLP nonlinearities, and full-model cascade. Only the paired WikiText evaluation can establish a quality change.

baseline_reference.calibration_split_and_tokens: train, 1024 token IDs, uniform windows, seed 42, seq_len 128
baseline_reference.heldout_split_and_tokens: validation, 1024 token IDs, uniform windows, seed 43, seq_len 128
baseline_reference.evaluation_split_and_tokens: test, 10000 input tokens / 9999 shifted labels, seq_len 2048, stride 512

interpretation_gate: Do not accept the method on the TT-SVD score alone. Compare it against the paired identity-order four-layer run on the same pinned model, WikiText test tokens, and compressed-prefix calibration stream. Require lower raw WikiText PPL and higher dense top-1 agreement; report checkpoint bytes and held-out block errors. MMLU remains a separate required full-model check.

local_unit_tests.coverage: 24 exact coordinate permutations on a rectangular projection, artifact reconstruction inversion, TT-SVD full-rank order invariance, one small compiler order-control comparison, invalid-order rejection, and existing compressed-prefix selection controls
